name: Project registration and repository onboarding
userOutcome: The user can register a new or existing software project and obtain a truthful validated project record without granting access to unrelated files.
productionDataSource: Local filesystem and Git repository inspection through the Rust control plane, persisted in SQLite.
errorBehavior: Keep entered configuration, identify the failing check safely, and allow correction or retry without a partial project.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not scan the home directory.
Do not create the project before validation succeeds.
Do not expose credentials or sensitive paths in ordinary errors.
